The '''Pinperu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. It was connected to the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari]] and [[Damendine system/Legends|Damendine]] systems by the [[Tidal Circuit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].
